title: [BUG] "Don't Ask Again" Overwrites Entire Permissions Array
author: jessicawestbrook

top_comments.author: chilts
top_comments.body:
I am also getting this problem and it is very frustrating. Having to say yes to something I've said yes to already (multiple times now due to this bug) gets unwieldy.

My workaround is that my `.claude/settings.local.json` file is checked in to git, so I just `git checkout .claude/settings.local.json` regularly, usually after I have finished a task and done a `/clear`. I've also quit claude at this point, re-run it, but still it manages to lose the `permissions.allow` array pretty soon, as @jess

top_comments.author: DanielHaddon
top_comments.body: Yeah this is a very annoying issue.

top_comments.author: BR4096
top_comments.body: This claude-settings.json corruption started to occur in v2.0.12 (Claude Code) MacOS earlier today each time the file was read.
